newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccan floods kill six, 43 houses collapse.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan floods kill six, 43 houses collapse.

text.p: Heavy rains in Morocco this month killed six people and destroyed 43 houses and four bridges, Interior Minister Driss Basri told a parliamentary commission.

The Moroccan official news agency MAP on Sunday reported Basri as telling the commission that 22 of Morocco's 65 provinces and prefectures had recorded 200 mm of rain, with some getting more than 500 mm.
Latest official figures show average rainfall for the 1994-1995 season, running from September to May, at a total of 225.4 mm.
Basri was speaking late on Friday.
At least 25 people died and thousands were made homeless last winter following steady downpours.
